title: Platen Impression Shear & Ink Squash Mechanics
discipline: Platen Press Micro-Fluidics · Ink Squash (Quetschrand) · Cotton Paper Elastoplasticity · Letterpress Tactile Deboss
hypothesis: Can digital typography simulate the micro-fluidic shearing and elastoplastic paper deboss of a letterpress platen impression (governed by the Stefan-Reynolds lubrication equation F = (3π·η·R⁴)/(2h³)·(dh/dt) and Bingham plastic yield stress), demonstrating that increasing vertical impression pressure (P = 5–30 MPa) forces high-viscosity ink outward into an authentic microscopic 'ink squash' halo rim (Quetschrand) while embossing paper fibers into permanent tactile relief, proving that the legendary 'bite' of letterpress is a three-dimensional fluid-structure phenomenon rather than a flat surface stamp?
